hardRules: x active female characters in an episode = exactly x acts.
Each act has one female as the primary POV/route focus.
A female may be mentioned outside her act, but her major decision/state-change belongs to her own act.
Secondary women are active characters with independent desire, decisions, information and consequences; never decorative jealousy props.
Private setups use ordinary reason -> private geography -> pressure -> control valve -> consequence.
Private geography is a pressure condition, not automatic escalation.
Do not repeatedly narrate or manufacture boundaries. Use natural dialogue, action, environment and aftermath.
Major payoff should be protagonist-authored where possible: choose, initiate, redirect, redesign, restart or end.
Every act must leave a measurable state change that carries forward.
DHIKA contributes craft architecture only. Do not copy DHIKA characters, prose, locations or plot events.

episode13.title: Four Closed Doors
actJobs: Mira: deliberately authors a kiss and its exit.
Rhea: admits attraction without converting it into action.
Naina: converts accidental proximity into deliberate continuation, then exits on environment change.
Neha: marriage becomes informed about Arjun-Rhea attraction; Neha gains independent jealousy/curiosity state.
